# @amykit/plugin-prove

Proves a phase against the real system: one workflow walks the scenario each brief settled, through the operations the mounted plugins offer.

A workflow for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy): a pure `plan()` that says what
happens next, and a runtime that says how each step is done. The engine drives it without
knowing what any of its states mean.

## Calling it

It takes an input, so it is called from a state of another workflow rather than mounted
as a profile. Depend on it from the package that calls it, mark the state `call` in that
workflow's diagram, draw an edge out of it named for each end (`refused`, `PROVEN`), and bind it:

```ts
import { plugin as prove } from "@amykit/plugin-prove";

calls: { STATE: call(prove, { input: (work) => ({ /* … */ }) }) },
```

Its settings below are set per call site, with `config` on the binding.

## The lifecycle

| State | Kind |
| :-- | :-- |
| `READING` | initial, waiting |
| `LEASING` | waiting |
| `PREPARING` | working |
| `refused` | terminal |
| `RUNNING` | working |
| `ASKING` | waiting |
| `PROVEN` | terminal |

It emits `ask`, `escalate`, `finish`, `lease`, `prepare`, `renew` and `run-step`.

## Configuration

```ts
call(prove, { config: { digest: "", fixtures: {}, policy: { askEveryMs: 60000, fixtureDeadlineMs: 86400000, leaseTtlMs: 600000, seatRetryMs: 30000 }, resources: {} } })
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `digest` | `string` | no | `""` | the command, by the name the commands port allows, that prints the digest of the code a proof certifies. Empty where the unit has no code |
| `fixtures` | `record` | no | `{}` | states a scenario starts from, shared by name: `{ ensure: [{ check: { operation, input, expect }, act: { operation, input } }] }` |
| `policy.askEveryMs` | `number` | no | `60000` | how often a run waiting on a person looks for the answer |
| `policy.fixtureDeadlineMs` | `number` | no | `86400000` | how long a person has to make a fixture hold before the run gives up |
| `policy.leaseTtlMs` | `number` | no | `600000` | how long a seat on a resource lasts without its run renewing it |
| `policy.seatRetryMs` | `number` | no | `30000` | how long a run waits before asking again for a seat or a scenario |
| `resources` | `record` | no | `{}` | what a scenario runs against, by name: `{ capacity, up, check, down }`, each a command the commands port allows. `check` is required |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.

## What it brings

| Command | What it does |
| :-- | :-- |
| `amy prove record` | Record a scenario a person ran by hand as the unit's proof |
| `amy prove show` | Say whether a unit is proven for the code and brief it is at now |

Typed on a machine that mounted this package, and unknown on one that did not.
